body:
domain:devx#2 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYmTYfaPbLQD4BJfomW

Filing gate ①: a checklist assertion fix, the same stale-History-tab family as #27492. It came out of PR #27651 (#27492, os-dev report 6502299806, `out_of_scope_findings`). Filed by `domain:devx` seat 2 (#20163) · `os-justin` · `session_01QSeKYmTYfaPbLQD4BJfomW`. ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ Filed without `domain:*`: the locations span `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` (`domain:devx`) and `examples/app-showcase/**` (triage's call by landing site), so triage sets the lane.
Business reason: record page v3 (#27055) draws no History tab at any width. Its `buildDefaultTabs` emits Details / Timeline / Related / Approvals, and `buildDefaultPageSchema.test.ts` asserts "no Activity or History tab". A runner that follows these steps finds no tab, so the clause scores red or BLOCKED while the product works as designed. Every release sweep re-diagnoses it, which hides real reds in the same items.
Reader who acts: the lane triage assigns. One os-dev, one PR, revision bumps on the two items. The fix should follow the shape PR #27651 gives `records-forms.field-history-tracking`: the record page's `sys_audit_log` read, and the timeline stream's Changes chip per width tier (`recordPageTierFor`).
Dedupe: `History tab` grepped over `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` and `examples/app-showcase` at `origin/main` `9d5ebfdef0`. The only hits are the locations below and the item #27492 re-points. #27312 (the spec describe() of `enable.trackHistory`) is a sibling on the spec side and does not cover these.

## Measured (`origin/main` `9d5ebfdef0`)

Enumeration pin (every location; the acceptance grep below must reach zero):
- `records-forms.crud-roundtrip` (revision 15), acceptance[4].verify: "after a screenshot confirms the History tab ren…"
- `records-forms.crud-roundtrip`, steps[5]: "open the record's History tab (screenshot first, then read entries)"
- `records-forms.record-edit-undo` (revision 5), acceptance[2].verify: "after screenshot of the History tab, the audit/read shows the revert as its own update"
- `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/account.object.ts:37`, a comment: "Show the record **History tab** (audit-trail UI). The console gates the tab on object-level `enable.trackHistory` …". The flag now gates the page's audit-log read and the stream's field-change lines, not a tab.

## Wanted

Re-point the three checklist clauses to the v3 surface, in the same terms #27651 lands for `field-history-tracking`. Bump each item's revision and add history entries. Correct the showcase comment. ⛔ No product code.

## Acceptance

`git grep -n -i 'history tab' -- docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas examples/app-showcase` → 0 hits, apart from a history entry that quotes the old text. `pnpm check:platform-checklist` is green.
